mergedParams.userDescription: Volumetric lighting and god rays. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Volumetric Lighting & God Rays Internal Effects

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'VolumetricRaysRadial' that simulates volumetric god rays emanating from behind text/media elements. This effect should use multiple layered generic animations targeting pseudo-elements or overlay divs. The effect creates animated light beams using CSS gradients and transforms. Key features: 1) Radial gradient masks that animate opacity from 0 to 0.3 in a pulsing pattern, 2) Multiple beam layers with different rotation angles (0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg), 3) Scale animations that expand from scale(0.8) to scale(1.2) creating a breathing effect, 4) Blur filter that animates from 20px to 0px for depth-of-field effect. The effect accepts parameters for: rayCount (2-8), rayColor (hex), rayIntensity (0-1), pulseDuration (ms), raySpread (degrees). Use AnimationRange[] with ease-in-out easing for smooth organic motion. Each ray layer should have slightly offset timing for natural movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Return format: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: params.start || 0, duration: params.duration || 3000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.15, 0.3, 0.15, 0], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'scale', val: [0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.0, 0.8], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'filter', val: ['blur(20px)', 'blur(10px)', 'blur(0px)', 'blur(10px)', 'blur(20px)'], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }], easing: 'ease-in-out' }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), rayCount: z.number().min(2).max(8).default(4), rayColor: z.string().default('#ffffff'), rayIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.5), pulseDuration: z.number().default(3000), raySpread: z.number().default(45) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Build an internal waveform effect preset named 'AudioVolumetricPulse' that creates audio-reactive volumetric lighting synchronized to bass frequencies. This effect should make text/media elements appear to emit pulsing light halos that react to music beats. The effect uses waveform data to modulate: 1) A glow filter that intensifies with bass hits (0px to 40px blur + color spread), 2) Scale transforms that pulse from 1.0 to 1.15 on beats, 3) Brightness filter that flares from 100% to 150% on peaks, 4) Opacity overlays that flash from 0 to 0.4 creating light burst effects. Parameters include: sensitivity (0-1 for reaction strength), threshold (0-1 for trigger level), glowColor (hex), decaySpeed (ms for effect falloff), multiplyMode (boolean for blend mode). The effect should track bass and mid frequencies for rich response.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (audio-reactive). Return format: { effects: [{ type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: params.duration || -1, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, props: { type: 'exposure', sensitivity: params.sensitivity || 0.7, threshold: params.threshold || 0.3, audioProperty: 'bass', maxScale: 1.15, glowIntensity: params.glowIntensity || 40, decaySpeed: params.decaySpeed || 150 } }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), sensitivity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.7), threshold: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.3), glowColor: z.string().default('#ffeb3b'), decaySpeed: z.number().default(150), multiplyMode: z.boolean().default(true) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { presets: [] } }

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset 'CinematicLightLeak' that simulates vintage film light leaks and volumetric atmospheric effects. This combines multiple generic animations: 1) Diagonal light streak overlays that sweep across the target using translateX(-100%) to translateX(200%) with varying speeds, 2) Color overlay animations cycling through warm tones (#ff6b35, #ffab00, #fff59d) with low opacity, 3) Contrast and brightness filters that fluctuate to simulate film exposure variations, 4) Vignette effects using radial gradients that pulse in intensity. Accept parameters for: leakDirection ('left-right', 'right-left', 'top-bottom'), leakColor (primary tint), leakIntensity (0-1), flickerAmount (0-1 for exposure variation), duration (ms). Use spring easing for organic motion and stagger multiple leak layers with offset timings.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (combined AnimationRange[]). Return format: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 4000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'translateX', val: ['-100%', '0%', '100%', '200%'], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.3, 0.3, 0], prog: [0, 0.2, 0.8, 1] }, { key: 'filter', val: ['brightness(1) contrast(1)', 'brightness(1.3) contrast(0.9)', 'brightness(1.1) contrast(1.1)', 'brightness(1) contrast(1)'], prog: [0, 0.33, 0.66, 1] }], easing: 'spring' }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), leakDirection: z.enum(['left-right', 'right-left', 'top-bottom']).default('left-right'), leakColor: z.string().default('#ffab00'), leakIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.6), flickerAmount: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.3), duration: z.number().default(4000) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'VolumetricDepthFog' that adds atmospheric depth and god ray effects through layered fog animations. This effect creates multiple depth planes: 1) Foreground fog that moves slowly with translateY and low opacity (0.1-0.2), 2) Midground light rays that rotate subtly (-5deg to 5deg) and pulse in opacity, 3) Background atmospheric haze using blur filters (0-10px) that creates depth. The effect should animate: opacity gradients for fog density, transform3d for parallax movement, filter combinations (blur + brightness) for atmospheric scattering. Parameters: fogDensity (0-1), rayAngle (degrees), parallaxSpeed (multiplier), fogColor (hex), layerCount (1-5). Each layer moves at different speeds creating volumetric depth. Use ease-in-out for natural atmospheric movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (multi-layer AnimationRange[]). Return format: { effects: Array.from({ length: params.layerCount }, (_, i) => ({ type: 'generic', start: i * 100, duration: params.duration || 5000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'opacity', val: [0, params.fogDensity * 0.3, params.fogDensity * 0.5, params.fogDensity * 0.3, 0], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'translateY', val: [`${i * 10}%`, `${i * 5}%`, `${i * -5}%`, `${i * -10}%`, `${i * 10}%`], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'blur', val: [0, i * 2, i * 4, i * 2, 0], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }], easing: 'ease-in-out' })) }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), fogDensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.5), rayAngle: z.number().default(15), parallaxSpeed: z.number().default(1), fogColor: z.string().default('#e3f2fd'), layerCount: z.number().min(1).max(5).default(3), duration: z.number().default(5000) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset 'HolyLightBurst' that creates dramatic god ray bursts emanating from text/media centers, like divine light breaking through clouds. The effect combines: 1) Radial scale animations from scale(0) to scale(2) for expanding light burst, 2) Opacity fades creating light bloom effect (0 to 0.8 to 0), 3) Multiple rotation layers spinning at different speeds for dynamic rays, 4) Color temperature shifts from cool (#e1f5fe) to warm (#fff9c4) simulating sunlight. Parameters include: burstIntensity (0-1), rayRotationSpeed (deg/s), bloomRadius (scale factor), warmthAmount (0-1 for color temp), burstDuration (ms). Each burst should have a hold period at peak intensity before fading. Use ease-out for explosive expansion, ease-in for gentle fade.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (compound AnimationRange[]). Return format: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: params.delay || 0, duration: params.burstDuration || 2000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'scale', val: [0, 1.5, 2, 2, 1], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.8, 0.8, 0.4, 0], prog: [0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1] }, { key: 'rotate', val: [0, params.rayRotationSpeed * 0.5, params.rayRotationSpeed, params.rayRotationSpeed * 1.5, params.rayRotationSpeed * 2], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'backgroundColor', val: ['#e1f5fe', '#fff9c4', '#ffffff', '#fff9c4', 'transparent'], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1] }], easing: 'ease-out' }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), burstIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.8), rayRotationSpeed: z.number().default(180), bloomRadius: z.number().default(2), warmthAmount: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.7), burstDuration: z.number().default(2000), delay: z.number().default(0) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Build an internal waveform effect preset 'FrequencyLightBeams' that creates volumetric light beams reacting to different frequency bands in audio. This effect maps: 1) Bass frequencies to beam width (scale X from 1 to 1.5), 2) Mid frequencies to beam intensity (opacity 0.2 to 0.8), 3) Treble to beam color temperature (filter hue-rotate), 4) Overall waveform to beam movement (translateY oscillation). The beams should appear as vertical shafts of light with soft edges. Parameters: beamCount (1-10), baseColor (hex), frequencyMapping (which bands to track), responseSpeed (ms), beamSpacing (px). Each beam reacts independently to create a light organ effect. Use threshold detection for clean triggering.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (multi-frequency reactive). Return format: { effects: Array.from({ length: params.beamCount }, (_, i) => ({ type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: -1, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`${params.targetIds[0]}-beam-${i}`], props: { type: 'scale', audioProperty: i % 3 === 0 ? 'bass' : i % 3 === 1 ? 'mid' : 'treble', sensitivity: params.sensitivity || 0.8, threshold: params.threshold || 0.2, maxScale: 1.5, minScale: 1.0, responseSpeed: params.responseSpeed || 100 } })) }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), beamCount: z.number().min(1).max(10).default(5), baseColor: z.string().default('#00e5ff'), frequencyMapping: z.array(z.enum(['bass', 'mid', 'treble'])).default(['bass', 'mid', 'treble']), responseSpeed: z.number().default(100), beamSpacing: z.number().default(20), sensitivity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.8), threshold: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.2) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset 'AtmosphericScatter' that simulates light scattering through volumetric atmosphere, creating soft god rays and ambient glow. This effect layers: 1) Gaussian blur gradients that animate from 0 to 30px creating depth fog, 2) Multiple opacity layers with different blend modes (screen, overlay, soft-light), 3) Transform skews that create angled light shafts (-15deg to 15deg), 4) Brightness and contrast adjustments simulating atmospheric density. Parameters: scatterAmount (0-1), atmosphereColor (hex), densityVariation (0-1), windSpeed (for drift animation), glowRadius (px). The effect should create subtle, cinematic atmosphere rather than harsh rays. Use long durations with ease-in-out for gentle atmospheric changes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (layered AnimationRange[]). Return format: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 8000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'filter', val: ['blur(0px) brightness(1)', `blur(${params.glowRadius * 0.5}px) brightness(1.1)`, `blur(${params.glowRadius}px) brightness(1.2)`, `blur(${params.glowRadius * 0.5}px) brightness(1.1)`, 'blur(0px) brightness(1)'], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, params.scatterAmount * 0.4, params.scatterAmount * 0.6, params.scatterAmount * 0.4, 0], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'transform', val: ['skewX(-15deg)', 'skewX(-7deg)', 'skewX(0deg)', 'skewX(7deg)', 'skewX(15deg)'], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }], easing: 'ease-in-out' }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), scatterAmount: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.6), atmosphereColor: z.string().default('#b3e5fc'), densityVariation: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.5), windSpeed: z.number().default(1), glowRadius: z.number().default(30), duration: z.number().default(8000) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'CrepuscularRays' that generates realistic crepuscular rays (sunbeams through clouds) as animated overlays. The effect creates: 1) Fan-shaped light rays using conic gradients with animated rotation, 2) Intensity variations simulating cloud movement (opacity 0-0.5 with holds), 3) Perspective transforms creating depth (perspective(1000px) rotateX), 4) Color temperature animations from dawn (#ff6b9d) through noon (#ffd93d) to dusk (#6c5ce7). Parameters: timeOfDay ('dawn', 'noon', 'dusk'), raySpread (degrees), cloudMovement (boolean), perspectiveDepth (px), rayCount (2-12). Rays should have natural variance in timing and intensity. Use custom easing curves for realistic cloud shadow movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (complex AnimationRange[]). Return format: { effects: Array.from({ length: params.rayCount }, (_, i) => ({ type: 'generic', start: i * 200, duration: params.duration || 6000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.2 + (i * 0.05), 0.4 + (i * 0.05), 0.2 + (i * 0.05), 0], prog: [0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1] }, { key: 'transform', val: [`perspective(${params.perspectiveDepth}px) rotateX(${-20 + i * 5}deg) rotate(${i * params.raySpread}deg)`, `perspective(${params.perspectiveDepth}px) rotateX(${-10 + i * 5}deg) rotate(${i * params.raySpread + 5}deg)`, `perspective(${params.perspectiveDepth}px) rotateX(${i * 5}deg) rotate(${i * params.raySpread + 10}deg)`, `perspective(${params.perspectiveDepth}px) rotateX(${10 + i * 5}deg) rotate(${i * params.raySpread + 5}deg)`, `perspective(${params.perspectiveDepth}px) rotateX(${20 + i * 5}deg) rotate(${i * params.raySpread}deg)`], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'backgroundColor', val: params.timeOfDay === 'dawn' ? ['#ff6b9d', '#feca57', '#ffd93d', '#feca57', '#ff6b9d'] : params.timeOfDay === 'dusk' ? ['#6c5ce7', '#a29bfe', '#fd79a8', '#a29bfe', '#6c5ce7'] : ['#ffd93d', '#ffffff', '#fff59d', '#ffffff', '#ffd93d'], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }], easing: 'ease-in-out' })) }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), timeOfDay: z.enum(['dawn', 'noon', 'dusk']).default('noon'), raySpread: z.number().default(15), cloudMovement: z.boolean().default(true), perspectiveDepth: z.number().default(1000), rayCount: z.number().min(2).max(12).default(6), duration: z.number().default(6000) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal combined effect preset 'VolumetricPortal' that creates a swirling vortex of light rays suitable for mystical or sci-fi contexts. This effect combines both generic and waveform effects: 1) Generic spiral rotation animation continuously rotating 0-360deg, 2) Scale pulsing from 0.8 to 1.3 creating portal breathing, 3) Waveform-reactive glow intensity tied to audio energy, 4) Color cycling through ethereal hues (#00ffff, #ff00ff, #ffff00) with audio modulation. Parameters: portalSpeed (rotation rpm), portalSize (scale), audioReactive (boolean), colorScheme ('ethereal', 'fire', 'ice', 'cosmic'), glowIntensity (0-1). The portal should have inner and outer rings rotating in opposite directions. Mix generic keyframes with audio reactivity for dynamic results.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined (generic + waveform). Return format: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 10000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'rotate', val: [0, 90, 180, 270, 360], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'scale', val: [0.8, 1.0, 1.3, 1.0, 0.8], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }], easing: 'linear' }, ...(params.audioReactive ? [{ type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: -1, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, props: { type: 'exposure', audioProperty: 'waveform', sensitivity: 0.9, threshold: 0.1, glowIntensity: params.glowIntensity * 50 } }] : [])] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), portalSpeed: z.number().default(30), portalSize: z.number().default(1.2), audioReactive: z.boolean().default(true), colorScheme: z.enum(['ethereal', 'fire', 'ice', 'cosmic']).default('ethereal'), glowIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.8), duration: z.number().default(10000) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { presets: [] } }

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset 'SubsurfaceGlow' that simulates subsurface scattering and internal illumination, making text/media appear to glow from within like backlit frosted glass. This effect creates: 1) Multi-layer blur halos with decreasing opacity (blur 5px at 0.6, 10px at 0.4, 20px at 0.2), 2) Color bleeding using CSS filters and blend modes, 3) Edge highlighting using inset shadows and borders, 4) Subtle pulsing using brightness and saturation filters. Parameters: glowCore (hex color), glowFalloff (sharp/medium/soft), subsurfaceDepth (1-5 layers), pulseRate (bpm), edgeIntensity (0-1). Each glow layer should stack to create volumetric internal lighting. Use combination of filters, shadows, and transforms for realistic subsurface effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (multi-layer filter stack). Return format: { effects: Array.from({ length: params.subsurfaceDepth }, (_, i) => ({ type: 'generic', start: i * 50, duration: params.duration || 3000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'filter', val: [`blur(${(i + 1) * 5}px) brightness(1) saturate(1)`, `blur(${(i + 1) * 5}px) brightness(${1 + (0.1 * (params.subsurfaceDepth - i))}) saturate(1.2)`, `blur(${(i + 1) * 5}px) brightness(${1 + (0.2 * (params.subsurfaceDepth - i))}) saturate(1.5)`, `blur(${(i + 1) * 5}px) brightness(${1 + (0.1 * (params.subsurfaceDepth - i))}) saturate(1.2)`, `blur(${(i + 1) * 5}px) brightness(1) saturate(1)`], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.6 - (i * 0.1), 0.8 - (i * 0.15), 0.6 - (i * 0.1), 0], prog: [0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1] }, { key: 'textShadow', val: [`0 0 ${(i + 1) * 10}px ${params.glowCore}`, `0 0 ${(i + 1) * 15}px ${params.glowCore}`, `0 0 ${(i + 1) * 20}px ${params.glowCore}`, `0 0 ${(i + 1) * 15}px ${params.glowCore}`, `0 0 ${(i + 1) * 10}px ${params.glowCore}`], prog: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }], easing: 'ease-in-out' })) }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), glowCore: z.string().default('#00ffff'), glowFalloff: z.enum(['sharp', 'medium', 'soft']).default('medium'), subsurfaceDepth: z.number().min(1).max(5).default(3), pulseRate: z.number().default(60), edgeIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.7), duration: z.number().default(3000) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }
